critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to accumulate features (manifesto, tension-proposals, sources on revise). Router split (auth/corpus/editorial/ask/tts/manifesto) is now overdue.

Approving a tension proposal permanently mutates the base atlas (per spec) — but there's no admin UI to un-approve or roll back if a mistake is made; consider a soft-delete/withdraw path in a future iteration.

/tts silently falls back on invalid voice; that is user-friendly but the response gives no signal about which voice was actually used. Consider surfacing the used voice via a response header (e.g., X-TTS-Voice) so clients can reflect the fallback.
Sources editor persists year as string vs number is not visually validated on client — recommend enforcing input type=number or numeric-only mask to avoid mixed types in DB.
